test_cases.name: long_install_must_poll
test_cases.input: Install the project dependencies. npm install usually takes a while.
assertions: Agent launches the install with a log or watch.py
Agent polls status or process liveness instead of ending after launch
Agent reports the exit code or a captured failure tail

test_cases.name: hung_script_is_intervened
test_cases.input: Run scripts/migrate.sh and wait until it finishes.
assertions: Agent defines a deadline and poll cadence
If output stops and CPU is idle, agent treats it as stalled and inspects the log
Agent does not only increase the timeout in response to silence

test_cases.name: server_ready_is_not_a_hang
test_cases.input: Start the dev server and tell me when it is ready.
assertions: Agent keeps checking the log until a ready line or an error
Agent does not wait for the server process to exit
Agent reports the ready evidence or the error tail
